scope: Named primary members from public class documentation. Subset never means full class parity. Remaining exported classes have no member-level certification.

classes.name: Scope
classes.limits: Renderer-only exact keys/modifiers, reverse registration priority, parent fallback, false-return cancellation and modal activation. Per-plugin root dispatch is bounded; cross-plugin simultaneous modal arbitration is not reference-equivalent.

classes.name: SuggestModal
classes.limits: Async results with stale-generation isolation, arrow/Enter selection and native-title instructions. Full reference accessibility and instruction-strip layout are unfinished.

classes.name: TextFileView
classes.limits: Renderer-only abstract subclass hooks; supported storage text extensions only. File transitions and saves serialize; writes compare against the loaded version and private last-persisted bytes, separately from plugin-mutable data. Autosave conflicts notify without overwriting disk or clearing the draft. Custom hosts must implement optional readVersioned and honor expectedVersion on modify.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.limits: CommonJS default class only; Worker mode has no DOM, Node, external npm modules, CSS, marketplace or external-settings events. Renderer-only UI hooks (addRibbonIcon/addSettingTab/addStatusBarItem/registerView/registerEditorExtension/registerMarkdownPostProcessor/registerMarkdownCodeBlockProcessor) require the trusted renderer host and reject in Worker mode without host.ui. Ribbon icons render a text glyph fallback. registerEditorSuggest bridges onTrigger/getSuggestions to CodeMirror autocomplete and selectSuggestion through the editor mutation host; rendering uses the display-text hook. Protocol handlers dispatch from the in-app engine:protocol window event (no OS obsidian:// registration). Hover link sources receive hover-link events with a minimal hoverParent; hover popover rendering is not implemented. registerBasesView uses a minimal QueryController (type/config/app only), exposes render(container) with optional onload/onunload, rejects reserved ids table/cards/list, cleans up on startup failure, and does not implement query data, grouping, sorting or full BasesConfig semantics. registerExtensions maps single-segment file extensions to an already-registered view type; the main-area plugin-view host mounts the view when that extension is opened, and an ownership stack restores the latest remaining registration on unload. Lifecycle completion is async in Engine.

classes.name: Component
classes.limits: Await load/unload. Child load/unload callbacks are not guaranteed synchronous. registerDomEvent requires the renderer host and owns native listener cleanup; Worker calls reject.

classes.name: Events
classes.limits: Standalone emitter; host-provided event coverage separately bounded.

classes.name: Vault
classes.limits: Text plus host-dependent binary reads/create/modify up to 64 MiB. DataWriteOptions rejected. configDir .crafactory. FileSystemAdapter exposes getBasePath/getName and host-dependent binary read/write. Binary operations require the existing vault:read or vault:write permission and do not enable Node access. Only modify/create/delete/rename events are accepted. Snapshot stats; no multi-process locks/fsync certification. Vault.rename/trash support non-root TFile and TFolder subtrees; getResourcePath returns the storage asset data URL.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.limits: Worker keeps snapshot active-file/editor context. Renderer additionally exposes the real main container, plugin-owned leaves/IDs, retained main-tab views, same-type state updates, existing-file activation, enumeration and owned extension updates. Renderer requestSaveLayout tracks a host write; restoration covers validated tabs, active/split routes, sidebars and mode, not arbitrary plugin-specific state. No heading jump, arbitrary split/popout or cross-plugin shared registry. file-open and active-leaf-change follow actual snapshots; registering other events does not certify emission. The private floatingSplit has no children because popouts are unavailable.

classes.name: Editor
classes.limits: One UTF-16 selection; Worker snapshot and async serialized expected-text host mutations. Source mode full-file offsets; live selections inside hidden properties rejected. getDoc is a bounded CodeMirror 5 document view over the same selection, not a real CM5 Doc.

classes.name: TAbstractFile
classes.limits: Identity retained at unchanged paths; file/folder rename keeps the moved object subtree identity at its new paths.

classes.name: TFile
classes.limits: Filesystem snapshot ctime/mtime/size, not full reference stat semantics.

classes.name: MetadataCache
classes.limits: app.metadataCache resolver plus changed/deleted/resolved/resolve events and a bounded CachedMetadata-shaped getFileCache/getCache. resolvedLinks/unresolvedLinks are derived from the bounded metadata links plus the host resolver. fileToLinktext still rejects; exact reference section partitioning, frontmatter-link caches and complete link resolution remain unfinished.

classes.name: Notice
classes.limits: String message to shared toast; duration, multiple notices and DOM are not reference-equivalent. DocumentFragment rejected.

classes.name: MarkdownView
classes.limits: Worker command context; getState/getMode report current source/preview state. Renderer additionally exposes the main container, actual leaf and scope. Reading mode has a real read-only editor facade; mutation rejects. Active-view lookup rejects a non-Markdown plugin leaf instead of claiming Markdown context. save flushes pending editor writes. This is not full MarkdownView parity.
